tools.name: mortgage_payment
tools.description: Monthly principal, interest, taxes, insurance, and HOA from the HomeMortgageOnline mortgage calculator. Missing inputs return "not available". Not a quote.

annualRatePercent.description: Annual interest rate percent. Do not omit this to use the page default.

monthlyHoa.description: Monthly HOA dues in dollars. Send 0 when there is no HOA.

tools.name: affordability
tools.description: Home price search from the affordability calculator. Every input is required. The page defaults (36% DTI, 30 years, 7.24%) are not filled in. Missing inputs return "not available".

propertyTaxPercent.description: Yearly property tax as a percent of home value.

insurancePercent.description: Yearly insurance as a percent of home value.

tools.name: refinance_break_even
tools.description: Break-even months from the refinance page: closing costs divided by monthly savings, rounded up. Or pass both loans and the principal-and-interest formula supplies the savings. Missing inputs return "not available".

tools.name: amortization_schedule
tools.description: Fixed-payment amortization using the mortgage calculator payment and the PMI calculator's balance step. Pass loanAmount, or price and downPayment. Schedule rows over 360 months return "not available".

tools.name: pmi_estimate
tools.description: Monthly PMI, LTV, and the removal walk from the PMI calculator. Missing inputs return "not available". The PMI rate is not a lender quote.

tools.name: closing_costs
tools.description: Cash to close from the closing-cost calculator. All fee inputs are required. Missing inputs return "not available". Not a Loan Estimate.

tools.name: loan_path_note
tools.description: Educational loan-path note already coded on the site. goal is veteran, rural, lowdown, highprice, refi, or conventional. credit may be fair or thin. Unknown goal returns "not available".

tools.name: published_rates
tools.description: Dated national rate prints already published on HomeMortgageOnline. Omit product for the full snapshot. An unknown product returns "not available". Not a quote.

tools.name: rate_outlook
tools.description: 30-year fixed history and scenario band from the rate outlook chart. Optional label such as 2024, Now, +1 mo, or +6 mo. An unknown label returns "not available".

tools.name: state_rate_context
tools.description: Looks up a state on the rates-by-state page. stateSpecificRate is "not available" because the site does not publish a separate state rate. Unknown state returns "not available".

tools.name: tax_itemize
tools.description: Mortgage-interest worksheet. Compares qualified interest plus other itemized amounts to a standard-deduction assumption you supply. No IRS table is filled in. Missing required inputs return "not available".

filingStatus.description: single, married_joint, married_separate, head_of_household, or surviving_spouse.

tools.name: tax_points
tools.description: Points worksheet: straight-line amortization or the simplified purchase-year illustration. Missing required inputs return "not available".

method.description: straight_line or purchase_year. Blank uses straight_line, matching the worksheet.

tools.name: tax_pmi_treatment
tools.description: PMI tax worksheet. Deductibility is not modeled unless optInCitedDeduction is true. No phaseout table is invented. Missing annual PMI returns "not available".

tools.name: tax_salt
tools.description: SALT worksheet. Property tax is a cash cost. A federal deduction is returned only when saltCapAssumption is supplied. Otherwise that deduction is "not available".

tools.name: tax_take_home_piti
tools.description: Take-home versus PITI worksheet. Missing required housing or take-home inputs return "not available".
